name: rl_sar_go2_himloco

provenance.policy: fan-ziqi/rl_sar policy/go2/himloco/himloco.pt (TorchScript), converted to ONNX by scripts/sim2sim_torchscript_to_onnx.py
provenance.deploy_config: policy/go2/himloco/config.yaml at that commit, transcribed below
provenance.obs_and_action_code: rl_sdk.cpp ComputeObservation / ComputeOutput; observation_buffer.cpp get_obs_vec 'time' priority (newest frame first, zero-initialised)
provenance.real_robot_claim: rl_sar README robot table marks Unitree-Go2 himloco (IsaacGym) as run on the real robot; maintainer-attested, not independently verified here

assumptions: trained_commands are HIMLoco go1_config.py ranges (the HIMLoco repo has no GO2 config; the rl_sar GO2 checkpoint's training config is not published)
rl_sar config.yaml hip action scale 0.125 used as shipped (HIMLoco go1 config uses 0.25 for all joints)
